actions.action: Inspect plants 1–2 hours after dark with a torch, hand-pick pests into soapy water, nightly for a week
If snails/slugs: lift pots onto stands or bricks
If snails/slugs: wrap copper tape around pots
If snails/slugs: scatter iron phosphate pellets on soil
If caterpillars: spray all leaf surfaces with Bt every 5–7 days for 2–3 weeks
Check top 2–3 cm of soil and water only when dry

reason: The answer correctly identifies chewing pests but misses the low-humidity cause and never suggests raising humidity or misting, which was the fix the poster credited; its pest and watering advice is unlikely to harm the plant.
